gloss: to design; to plan; to engineer

definitions.gloss: to design; to plan; to engineer
definitions.explanation: To create detailed plans or specifications for a structure, system, or product before it is built or implemented. Covers architectural, engineering, and software design.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいビルを{設計|せっけい}する。
このシステムは{安全性|あんぜんせい}を{重視|じゅうし}して{設計|せっけい}された。
examples.english: This system was designed with an emphasis on safety.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{若|わか}いころ、{有名|ゆうめい}な{建築家|けんちくか}のもとで{住宅|じゅうたく}を{設計|せっけい}する{仕事|しごと}をしていた。
examples.english: When my grandfather was young, he worked designing houses under a famous architect.

notes:
Primarily used for technical and professional design work — architecture, engineering, product development, software systems. Not used for artistic or fashion design, which uses デザインする instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {設計|せっけい}{図|ず}: blueprint; design drawing
- {設計|せっけい}{者|しゃ}: designer; engineer
- {設計|せっけい}{事務所|じむしょ}: design office; architectural firm
- {基本|きほん}{設計|せっけい}: basic design; conceptual design
- {詳細|しょうさい}{設計|せっけい}: detailed design

SIMILAR WORDS:
- デザインする: to design — used for visual, artistic, or fashion design
- {企画|きかく}する: to plan; to propose — focuses on the conceptual planning stage of a project
- {構想|こうそう}する: to conceive; to envision — emphasizes the initial idea-forming stage before detailed planning
